profile.Name: Alek the Bold
profile.Personality: Proud, curt, and quick to mock outsiders who talk too much. He holds that the Shek win their battles by their own swords or not at all, hates Okranites and the Shek Kingdom, and warms only to those who prove themselves, whom he calls kin.
profile.Backstory: Officer of the Bele'coz who speaks for Kraz. He speaks for Kraz, the Bele'coz Emperor, in Sakar, since Kraz saves his strength for combat rather than talk. He lost an arm in a defeat and now has a robotic one, having refused the traditional death so he could go on serving Kraz. He curses spiders and dares outsiders to kill the Stone Golem, the Phoenix, or the Bugmaster.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Clipped and scornful, with grunts like "Hmph!" and "Mmh!" and a mocking "Hm hm! Amusing." Calls strangers "outsider" and allies "kin", and warns Okranites that this is the land without gods.
